analysis_status: exploratory fixed local protocol; not public preregistration
research_question: Does source-train-only per-channel standardization improve four-class source-only EEGNet LOSO generalization relative to Q5-E001?
hypothesis: Source-derived channel scaling may mitigate cross-subject amplitude differences and class collapse, but benefit is not assumed.

training.epoch_selection: earliest epoch minimizing equal-inner-fold mean validation CE

evaluation.target_information: No target-subject fit, normalization, early stopping, seed choice, or hyperparameter tuning
evaluation.primary_population: all trials including expert artifact flags
evaluation.primary_metric: subject-level balanced_accuracy, then equal-subject mean of three-seed means
evaluation.inference: exploratory paired subject contrasts; no 27-independent-observation test

resource_benchmark.note: Inherited Q5 synthetic shape-matched CPU benchmark only, not a Q6 runtime measurement.

limitations: Q5/Q4 target outcomes and this experiment idea were already seen; Q6 is exploratory, not independent confirmation.
Forty-epoch cap and source-only CE selection are fixed to Q5; a selected boundary epoch may indicate undertraining.
Offline zero-phase run filtering is not a causal online pipeline.
No target-subject statistics are fitted, including unlabeled target signals.
